status: 60 scoped source/native reviews; six native query/read corrections; grouped build passes 15,169 fixed slots.

source_reviews.name: card_powerstone_minefield
source_reviews.reason: Native attacker byte is loaded before in_play at 0x2067bd5 and again after it at 0x2067c06. Remove cached card local; keep fresh current_turn arguments. Also retain native current-turn-first order for the two CHECK_PUMP writes (both players still receive -2).

source_reviews.name: card_dwarven_catapult
source_reviews.reason: Native queries instance on a paid non-token cast after played_for_free/is_token (0x2422665), or on resolution (0x24226d0), not at entry. Restore those query sites and explicit numerator snapshot before count_subtype. Preserve unguarded signed division, AI mana loop and dispatch on other events.

source_reviews.name: card_kjeldoran_outpost
source_reviews.reason: Native CAN_ACTIVATE path queries instance at 0x20a2d97 before mana_producer; the recovery previously skipped it. Include CAN_ACTIVATE in query dispatch and return the mana result after it; keep al_lands first and all activation/token paths unchanged.

source_reviews.name: card_darksteel_mutation
source_reviews.reason: Native snapshots attachment arguments before its first attachment lookup, then queries that saved pair again at 0x23c36b7 after create_a_card_type and stores. Restore fresh pointer for recalculation flags instead of reusing the pre-creation attachment pointer; retain cached-type fast path and allocation-failure return.

source_reviews.name: card_grim_haruspex
source_reviews.reason: Native own-instance lookup occurs after the STATIC_EFFECTS legacy search/creation (0x219dd3f); other events query before GFP processing. Move entry lookup to that common continuation, keeping fresh pointer after all static callbacks and before death counters/trigger checks.

source_reviews.name: card_thawing_glaciers
source_reviews.reason: Native has a second own-instance query for CAN_ACTIVATE without added mana, ACTIVATE, RESOLVE_ACTIVATION and CLEANUP, after EOT/bounce processing. Restore common requery after early mana/event returns, preserving original initial lookup for the bounce test and parent lookup on resolution.

review_notes: Scoped source/native reviews; unchanged candidates receive compact observations, not full-function closure.
Poison native split worker lacks the positive guard provided by its public entry at 0x26d4260; existing source guard retained.
Shattered Crypt already saves selected count before casting-cost callback and rereads info_slot afterward for payment eligibility in both native/current instructions; retained.
Reset-subtype masks, record widths, packed damage flags, Exiledby/meld scans and dispatch-only duplicated calls are not blanket equivalence proofs.
